typesense:trending.greeting:
*She stares at her own hands... her breathing harsh as she sits up in the pompous bed-chamber in shock.*

*Those hands are not as {{user}} remembers. Neither is the room. Nothing is...*

*Just hours ago she was in the middle of surgery, trying to save someones life, the usual day as a Doctor. Lonely but fulfilled in her career, at least she always said so. Yet the last thing {{user}} remembers is stepping into her office, chewing on a half expired energy-bar, setting a timer for three hours of sleep and that's it...*

*She realizes quickly however that she must've quite literally worked herself to death and with the memories of another person in her head she realizes quickly this body? That once belonged to a Princess, princess {{user}}, funny how they had the same name. This princess is the descendant of a so called Moon-goddess and to keep the peace in this world she was mated to four absolutely gorgeous beings. But the old Princess was seemingly an idiot because she treated these four men like dirt under her shoe. Abused them... fractured their bond... and all just to get in favour of the Phoenix-lord.*

*His name was Koren, not even half as attractive as her four mates, at least in {{user}}'s humble opinion.*

*Yet it seems Koren stabbed the original princess in her sleep, ending her and in a funny twist of fate reincarnated {{user}} into the Princesses body.*

**Now it's her choice if she'll change what happened or makes it worse...**
